text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N4","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT NOTE:- 1) TO BE HARDENED UPTO 32-35 HRC. 2) THREADS TO BE KEEP SOFT. 3) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"The note specifies hardness and that threads must be kept soft, but does not state at which manufacturing stage the hardening is to be performed (e.g., before or after final machining). Without a defined sequence the machinist cannot plan operations correctly, risking distortion of finished features or inability to machine hardened stock. The designer should add the process stage for the heat treatment in N4.","recommended_correction":"Update N4 to specify when hardening occurs relative to machining, e.g., 'HARDEN TO 32-35 HRC AFTER ROUGH MACHINING, BEFORE FINISH MACHINING.'"},{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D13","page":1,"quote":"-0.006"},{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D14","page":1,"quote":"-0.017"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N2","page":1,"quote":"# FINISH  :  IZBP"}],"comment":"Dimensions D13 and D14 carry negative tolerances of 0.006 mm and 0.017 mm respectively (bands well under 0.1 mm), yet the part is zinc plated per N2 with no allowance made for plating buildup on these tight features. Plating thickness will push these dimensions out of tolerance, preventing proper fit or assembly. The designer should either increase the pre-plate tolerance bands to absorb the coating thickness or add a note specifying undersize machining to compensate for the IZBP plating.","recommended_correction":"Adjust the tolerances on D13 and D14 to account for IZBP plating thickness, or add a note specifying the required pre-plate undersize dimension."}]}
